messages:
Alicia - Sales: Hey team — AcmeFi sent the SIG back and flagged three controls they want evidence for urgently: 3.1 (encryption at rest), 6.2 (access reviews), and 8.4 (incident response). Need consolidated responses + artifacts by EOD tomorrow. I created a folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME_SIG_PLACEHOLDER — please upload any docs/screenshots there and ping when done. @Ben can you lead the security answers?

Ben - Security: On it. I'll pull KMS/key rotation policy, our access review policy, and the IR runbook. Quick question: do we have a screenshot that shows encryption-at-rest enabled for Dedicated/Private deployments? We should include a config snippet for Hosted vs Private key handling.

Carol - Eng: We do. Summary: Dedicated + Private support customer-managed keys (integrations with AWS KMS / GCP KMS / HSM). Hosted uses service-managed keys by default. I'll upload a config snippet and the runtime doc. Example snippet for the Private deployment config:
```yaml
security:
  kms:
    enabled: true
    provider: aws_kms
    customer_managed: true
```
I'll also get a console screenshot showing disk/GPU volume encryption for the POC environment.

David - Solutions: I have the AcmeFi POC screenshots from last week — I'll sanitize and upload them. Also, customer asked about our access-review cadence (6.2) — what's the official line we want to provide?

Ben - Security: Our policy: quarterly access reviews for platform accounts, monthly for privileged roles in Dedicated customers. I'll upload the policy doc (redacted). For audit evidence, we should export CloudTrail / Audit Logs for the last 90 days and provide a sample of the review tickets. @Carol can infra export logs and redact PII?

Carol - Eng: Yep, I'll coordinate with infra. ETA: export + sanitize by 4:00pm PT today, then upload to the Drive folder. I'll include a short README describing what was redacted.

Alicia - Sales: Perfect. For incident response (8.4) they want a timeline example. Ben — do we have a sanitized IR timeline from a previous (non-customer-impacting) incident we can share?

Ben - Security: We have an internal postmortem (redacted) that shows the timeline and communications. I'll attach that and a one-page summary we can share with customers.

evidence-bot: New file uploaded to Drive: /SIG/AcmeFi/KMS-architecture-diagram.pdf

David - Solutions: Uploaded sanitized POC screenshots: https://drive.google.com/file/d/POC_SCREENSHOT_PLACEHOLDER (folder). Also added a short note on where to find instance-level encryption settings in the console.

Ben - Security: Uploaded access-review-policy.pdf and IR-summary-redacted.pdf. For the SIG Q about key rotation frequency, our baseline is 12 months for service-managed keys, customer-managed rotation as per customer's policy.

Carol - Eng: Logs export done and uploaded: /SIG/AcmeFi/cloudtrail_sample_90days.json (redacted). I added a README.txt describing redaction.

Alicia - Sales: This is great — I'm going to draft the SIG answers now. One ask: please confirm wording for the Hosted case so we don't imply CMK for Hosted customers. Draft line I plan to use: "Hosted: service-managed encryption keys; Dedicated/Private: customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM." Thumbs up if that's accurate.

Ben - Security: That's accurate. :thumbsup:

Carol - Eng: Accurate from runtime perspective. :+1:

Alicia - Sales: OK — I'll fill in answers for 3.1, 6.2, 8.4 and attach the artifacts. Plan to submit the completed SIG back to AcmeFi by 11:00am PT tomorrow unless anyone flags an issue.

Ben - Security: Minor note — for 3.1 include the KMS key policy snippet (I uploaded kms_key_policy.txt). Also mention automated key rotation where applicable.

David - Solutions: I'll review the draft after you post it in this thread, Alicia. Happy to call the customer with you if they want to go through details.

Alicia - Sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post the draft reply in this thread before EOD and then finalize in the Drive folder.

Carol - Eng: FYI, I added a tiny config diff showing how to enable CMK in Private: `/etc/redwood/config.yaml` patch attached.

evidence-bot: New file uploaded: /SIG/AcmeFi/access_review_sample.pdf

Alicia - Sales: Received. If no objections I'll mark this thread as ready after I attach the draft.

Ben - Security: No objections. Good to go from security side.

Alicia - Sales: Great — thanks all :rocket:
